title: Hurricane Florence
description: U. S. Army Soldiers assigned to 129th Combat Support Sustainment Battalion, 101st Airborne Division (Air Assault), 101st Airborne Division Sustainment Brigade “Lifeliners” and arrive to Fort Bragg North Carolina to join the ongoing joint operations conducted in support of Hurricane Florence Relief effort at Lumberton, North Carolina, Sept. 18, 2018. The 101st ABN Soldiers made the 22 hours trip from Fort Campbell, KY. (Photo by Spc. Andrea Salgado Rivera)
